findings.issue: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר is “and it was when/as” (preposition + relative). “fue como que” reads in current Latin American Spanish as semblance (“it was as if”), so the approach is no longer the temporal circumstance.
“desde sus manos” adds a source, a body part, and a possessor. The throw clause only licenses throwing the tablets.

notes: Calf, dances, nose of Moses, breaking them, and under the mountain match the packet.
